newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian Riga Commercial Bank eyes bourse Jan/Feb.
newsitem.headline: Latvian Riga Commercial Bank eyes bourse Jan/Feb.

text.p: One of Latvia's top commercial banks, Riga Commercial Bank, is heading for a stock market quote in January or February at the latest, a stock exchange official said on Wednesday.

Riga Commercial Bank has for some time been expected to start quoting its shares on the bourse but no date has been given. The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) recently bought a 23 percent stake in the bank.
"I am not sure the bank will manage to do that in January, but it will happen in February at the latest," a stock exchange official, who did not wish to be named, told Reuters.
Riga Commercial Bank is the third largest bank in Latvia. It had assets after 10 months of the year of 97.34 million lats, up from 73.21 million lats at the end of 1995.
The bank would be the first privately-owned bank to join the stockmarket and would join another leading bank, Unibanka. The EBRD also has shares in Unibanka and the state owns some 51 percent.
